purpose: Test municipal document-requirement-map, public verifier, and Polis deliberation for duplicate document handoff reduction.
scope: One civic issue (complaints process document duplication), one Polis deliberation conversation, one public document proof.
successMetrics: Redaction audit trail non-empty if redactions applied
redactionPolicy: Only pre-agreed privacy/security redactions. All redactions logged as audit events (eventType: pilot.result.redacted) with reason and authorizing authority. Partner cannot unilaterally delete results.
exitPlan: At sunset: archive all data, preserve public pages and audit trail as immutable record, export deliberation results, transfer any partner-specific data per agreement.
